name: NT DATA CENTER Hat Yai
notes: Official NT Data Center locations page lists Hat Yai as a key location with Tier 3 design and 40 racks; page states the area is under renovation with estimated completion June 2026. No MW capacity disclosed.

name: CloudHQ BKK Campus
notes: CloudHQ official campus page describes a planned 108 MW critical IT load site outside Bangkok; DataCenterMap places CloudHQ BKK in the Pattaya market at Bo Win, Si Racha District. Recorded under Phatthaya as Pattaya-market/EEC vicinity, not confirmed inside Pattaya city boundaries.

name: Amazon AWS BKK - Ta Sit
notes: AWS official Thailand page confirms the AWS Asia Pacific (Thailand) Region; DataCenterMap lists Amazon AWS BKK - Ta Sit in the Pattaya market at Eastern Seaboard Industrial Estate Rayong, Ta Sit, with year operational 2025. Exact facility location is outside Pattaya city and capacity is not disclosed by AWS.

name: Doma/STP Green Data Center Park - Chonburi/EEC
developer: Doma Infrastructure Group; Silicon Tech Park
notes: Silicon Tech Park and trade sources describe a 1.5 GW, three-park EEC program across Chachoengsao, Chonburi, and Rayong, with first facilities targeted for Q3 2026. Capacity shown here is an inferred one-third allocation for the Chonburi park; sources do not state a Pattaya-city site, and DCD characterizes the sites as outside Bangkok and Pattaya City.
